PROVISIONAL_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL. +Megrim +Rankle, Master of Pranks +Aggravated Assault +Raiders' Wake +Deadly Rollick / -Jet Medallion -Blizzard Specter -Dream Salvage -Oppression -Izzet Signet. 36 lands (unchanged), 11 mana rocks, average nonland MV 2.381, 25 instants/sorceries. Adds Spellbook 900-3750 (Sword of Feast and Famine + Aggravated Assault, conditional on connecting). Losses: black cost reduction, a Signet, Blizzard Specter's bounce mode, Dream Salvage's post-purge draw, Oppression's symmetric stax.

REJECT (four-swap, staged). The preferred five without Raiders' Wake, keeping Oppression. Oppression taxes our own 25 instants/sorceries and empties opponents' hands before Crosis's purge; Raiders' Wake is asymmetric and adds 2 life loss per discarded card. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (five-swap, staged). Pass C's reconciliation pairing: Megrim takes Sedraxis Specter's slot and Jet Medallion stays. Sedraxis is a three-mana recursive flyer (unearth) that feeds every punisher; Jet Medallion is the lowest-impact rock. HIGH confidence.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (six-swap, staged, not selected). The preferred five plus Bloodchief Ascension over Dark Deal. Once active it drains 2 per card put into an opponent's graveyard, but it needs three end steps to activate; Dark Deal is an immediate burst with Megrim, Caress and Wake. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (seven-swap, staged). The six-swap Bloodchief list plus Painful Quandary over Bottomless Pit. Five mana and opponents choose life or discard; Pit is a three-mana every-upkeep discard. MODERATE confidence.
